mechanism: Ganciclovir causes dose-dependent nephrotoxicity and acute kidney injury, impairing potassium excretion and leading to hyperkalemia; additive risk when potassium supplementation is concurrent.
action: Monitor serum potassium and renal function closely during ganciclovir therapy; use potassium supplementation only if serum levels are low and adjust based on renal function; consider alternative antivirals if significant renal impairment develops.
